title: Dr. Vinod falls into a trance and first channels the Nine
summary: Greg Malatzi tells of Dr. Vinod falls into a trance and first channels the Nine, about 1952 at Round Table Foundation, Maine, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

as_told.title: Early Vinod channeling of the Nine in 1952

related.note: Both describe the first channeling of the Nine at Puharich's group in Maine in 1952. This telling puts it at Dr. Vinod's unexpected trance on his first night, while the story puts it at a séance of nine people on New Year's Eve 1952-53.

plain: In 1952 a visitor known as Dr. Vinod came to the Round Table Foundation, a research group in Maine. A researcher, Greg Malatzi, says the story goes that on his very first night there, Vinod unexpectedly fell into a trance. According to the researchers, he then began channelling, meaning passing on messages said to come from another being, from a group called the Nine, which the podcast episode describes as an alien council. They point to tape recordings, session transcripts and the journals of Andrija Puharich, the man behind the foundation, as their sources. One telling speaks of the early channelling in 1952 in general rather than the first night. If true, it would mean humans made contact with non-human beings through a trance in the 1950s.
